$comment: Canonical E-L growth stage reference images for the Lovable portal. Copy this whole folder into the portal's public/growth-stages/. Files are the exact same source images bundled in both mobile apps (iOS Assets.xcassets EL*.imageset PNGs and Android drawable-nodpi el*.webp). All 1024x1024. Created in Canva under the project owner's account (XMP CreatorTool: 'Canva (Renderer)') — project-owned, no third-party licensing restriction. Resolution order must match mobile: a vineyard's custom uploaded image (growth_stage_images table / storage) wins; these bundled files are the fallback. Stages listed in 'stagesWithoutImage' have no reference photo on any platform — show a placeholder, never another stage's image.

images.description: First leaf separated from shoot tip
2 to 3 leaves separated; shoots 2-4 cm long
5 leaves separated; shoots about 10 cm long; inflorescence clear
12 leaves separated; inflorescence well developed, single flowers separated
About 16 leaves separated; beginning of flowering (first flower caps loosening)
Setting; young berries enlarging (>2 mm diam.), bunch at right angles to stem
Berries pepper-corn size (4 mm diam.); bunches tending downwards
Berries pea-size (7 mm diam.) (if bunches are tight)
Berries begin to colour and enlarge
